qc/runs/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r15/raw-evidence-index.json and the 22 artifacts it lists (hashes recomputed)
evidence: Paths named by the brief exist and are staged. instruction.md:3 says 'Please read the six notes in /instructions' and environment/instructions holds exactly six notes (behaviour, integration, overview, policy, security, ui); the notes' cross-references ('the boundary in security.md' in integration.md:5, 'as described in ui.md' in policy.md:3) resolve. instruction.md:3 and integration.md:7 name '/assets/seed_data.json'; environment/assets/seed_data.json exists (149 bytes), parses as JSON, and environment/Dockerfile has 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/', 'COPY assets/ /assets/' and 'chmod -R a+rX /instructions /assets'. task.toml has artifacts = ["/app", "/assets"]. Content matches what each party assumes. Brief: integration.md:7 says the seed 'describes the starting scope and contains no user snippets or starter implementation'; the file is {"snippets": [], "note": "No saved snippets are supplied in this seed. Build a JavaScript and HTML playground with durable revision history."}, which is exactly that and adds no requirement beyond the notes. Solution: solution/app/server.js and solve.sh never read /assets or any seed (no match for seed or /assets); the golden starts from an empty SQLite library, consistent with an empty seed, and its only static inputs (public/index.html, public/assets/index.js, public/assets/index.css, public/runner.html) are shipped in solution/app and served by express.static(path.join(root, 'public')). Judges: no gate prompt or criterion refers to /assets, a seed record or a pre-existing snippet; tests/app_context.md:24 says 'the library may already hold records from earlier checks. Do not assume an empty library', so no criterion depends on seeded or pristine content, and judges enter their own fixtures. No other input file (image, sample source, fixture) is named anywhere in the brief, notes, context or criteria, so none is missing. Weak-app and alternative checks: an app that ignores the seed and an app that reads it and imports zero snippets behave identically, so neither is wrongly graded; an app that wrongly assumed starter snippets would find none, and the brief says so. Runtime evidence: the scripted golden run on the previous commit's bytes (results/editor.json, runtime.json, polish.json all true, restart.json showing revision 2 with history [2, 1] after a process restart) confirms the golden works with these assets when installed by solve.sh; all 22 indexed artifact hashes were recomputed and match. Limits: that run was in the agent image, not through tests/test.sh in the verifier image, and no configured judge run exists for these bytes; this row's claims do not rest on judge behaviour. Notes (not defects): (1) the seed is a placeholder with no records, so the template phrase 'Starting records are in /assets/seed_data.json' was correctly replaced rather than kept; the row is close to N/A but Pass because the brief names the file and it is present and accurate. (2) The mechanical half (check-assets-referenced.py, check-fixtures.py) was applied by hand here; the private checker executables were not run.
